groups.comparison: Exact P16 capability554 fully read including source tests, never executed. F140 captures the five monotone armor tiers represented by four independent retained flags. Other melee/ranged/heavy axes are independent capabilities, not exclusive states. meets is an immediate recommendation predicate, not recruitment authorization. Numeric skill/precision/rating are continuous measured checks with display thresholds; no finite enum of arbitrary numeric values is demanded. Aggregate functions deliberately implement different contribution contracts: ordinary harmonic support, bounded complement support and Command that can be harmed by weak supporters. Preserve source sorting/tie/floating operation order, no blanket single aggregation owner. Religion/Bestiary knowledge use actual category/tradition learned hours and head health; unused focus/instinct parameters are separate API granularity concern, not justification to reintroduce fatigue/equipment terms. Optional precision label is a presentation result, not retained mode. TestArmor.shield Boolean is an immediate fixture adapter to shield bonus, not gameplay policy migration. No normal malformed capability or failed test claimed.
groups.disposition: F140 monotone tier shape; independent capabilities and recommendation semantics preserved

limits: Discovery only; no execution, fixes, checks, implementation plan or lens clearance.
